paper_title: Light Dark Matter Search with Ionization Signals in XENON1T
notes: Paper presents multiple DM constraints. For dark photon absorption (kinetic mixing kappa), only one explicit numerical point given in Table I: m=0.5 keV (5e5 eV), kappa=2.2e-16 at 90% CL. The exclusion covers dark photon DM masses 0.186-1 keV/c2 (panel F of Fig 5) but only the single tabulated point has explicit numerical values. The paper also reports ALP axioelectric coupling (gae=7.7e-14 at 0.5 keV) which would be AxionElectron; chose DarkPhoton per the dark photon kinetic mixing result. dm_density not explicitly stated in extracted text. | Vision: Used panel (F) Dark photons of Fig.5. The supplied axis calibration referred to panel (A) (cross-section), which is NOT the dark photon plot; I overrode it. X-axis 0.2-5 keV/c^2 converted to eV. Y-axis kinetic mixing kappa (right axis) with ticks 1e-16,1e-15,1e-14. Boundary anchored at Table I point (0.5 keV, kappa=2.2e-16). Lower boundary of exclusion traced; minimum near ~0.7 keV. | Calibration: No calibration needed
